name: sd_generators
description: SD 纹理/图案生成器库节点深度分析。覆盖 21 个核心生成器的内部引擎、参数、适用场景。 分为三类：图案生成器(tile_generator/splatter等)、噪波生成器(perlin/cells/voronoi等)、 特征纹理生成器(moisture_noise/wood_fibers等)。 Use when AI needs to: (1) choose the right generator for a material, (2) understand generator parameters for fine-tuning, (3) know which generators are FX-Map vs Pixel Processor based, (4) build custom patterns by combining generators. Substance Designer only (run_python).
author: Ivan(杨己力)
